speaker: Doctor

Have you noticed any blood mixed with your sputum, or have you experienced any night sweats or unintentional weight loss? REQUEST TEST: CT_Chest

speaker: Doctor
text: That is strange; the CT scan shows no masses or lymphadenopathy despite your three-week illness. Have you been exposed to anyone with tuberculosis recently, and do you have a history of smoking or living in an area with high pollution?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious bronchiectasis or organizing pneumonia (cryptogenic organizing pneumonia). The clinical picture of a chronic, subacute cough with right lower lobe consolidation, normal infectious workup, and lack of malignancy on CT suggests an organizing inflammatory process rather than active infection or cancer.
